\section{A Python Toolbox of Representational Analysis from Multi\sphinxhyphen{}modal Neural Data}
\label{\detokenize{index:a-python-toolbox-of-representational-analysis-from-multi-modal-neural-data}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
NeuroRA2 (an updated version of NeuroRA) is an easy\sphinxhyphen{}to\sphinxhyphen{}use toolbox based on Python, which can do some works about representational similarity analysis (RSA) among nearly all kinds of neural data, including behavioral, EEG, MEG, fNIRS, sEEG, ECoG, fMRI and some other neuroelectrophysiological data. In addition, users can do Inter\sphinxhyphen{}Subject Correlation (ISC), Classification\sphinxhyphen{}based EEG decoding and a novel cross\sphinxhyphen{}temporal RSA (CTRSA) on NeuroRA.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Author: Zitong Lu


\subsection{Documentation of NeuroRA}
\label{\detokenize{index:documentation-of-neurora}}
\sphinxstepscope


\subsubsection{Overview}
\label{\detokenize{overview:overview}}\label{\detokenize{overview::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) has become a popular and effective method to measure the representation of multivariable neural activity in different modes.

\sphinxAtStartPar
NeuroRA is an easy\sphinxhyphen{}to\sphinxhyphen{}use toolbox based on Python, which can do some works about RSA among nearly all kinds of neural data, including behavioral, EEG, MEG, fNIRS, sEEG, ECoG, fMRI and some other neuroelectrophysiological data. In addition, users can do Neural Pattern Similarity (NPS), Spatiotemporal Pattern Similarity (STPS) \& Inter\sphinxhyphen{}Subject Correlation (ISC) on NeuroRA.

\sphinxAtStartPar
NeuroRA includes some typical features below:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate the Neural Pattern Similarity (NPS)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate the Spatiotemporal Neural Pattern Similarity (STPS)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate the Inter\sphinxhyphen{}Subject Correlation (ISC)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate the Representational Dissimilarity Matrix (RDM)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate the Representational Similarity based on RDMs

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
One\sphinxhyphen{}Step Realize Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Statistical Analysis

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Save the RSA result as a NIfTI file for fMRI

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Visualization for RSA results

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Required Dependencies:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxhref{http://www.numpy.org}{Numpy}: a fundamental package for scientific computing.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxhref{https://www.scipy.org/scipylib/index.html}{SciPy}: a package that provides many user\sphinxhyphen{}friendly and efficient numerical routines.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxhref{https://matplotlib.org}{Matplotlib}: a Python 2D plotting library.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxhref{https://nipy.org/nibabel/}{NiBabel}: a package prividing read +/\sphinxhyphen{} write access to some common medical and neuroimaging file formats.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxhref{https://nilearn.github.io/}{Nilearn}: a Python module for fast and easy statistical learning on NeuroImaging data.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxhref{https://mne.tools/}{MNE\sphinxhyphen{}Python}: a Python software for exploring, visualizing, and analyzing human neurophysiological data.

\end{itemize}

\sphinxstepscope
